walkthroughs.body_html:
Renewable: wind, solar, hydro, biomass, tidal.

Non-renewable: coal, gas, oil, nuclear.

Arrows widths show energy.

Useful out / total in = efficiency.

mcqs.q: When energy is 'lost' as heat due to friction, what has really happened?
options: Energy has been used up and no longer exists.
Energy has been transferred to the thermal store of the surroundings — it's not destroyed, just dissipated.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between energy and power?
options: Power is the energy used over the lifetime of a device.
Energy and power are the same — both describe how much fuel something uses.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
Energy is measured in joules; power is the rate of energy transfer, measured in watts (joules per second).

mcqs.q: If a car doubles its speed, what happens to its kinetic energy?
options: Power is the energy used over the lifetime of a device.
Kinetic energy doubles because energy is proportional to speed.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
It quadruples (because KE = 1/2 mv^2 — kinetic energy is proportional to v^2).
